subject.title: refactor: remove pre-2026.4 compatibility shims and legacy migrations

question: What tagged upgrade and public API support window must the release after v2026.6.11 preserve before removing the Matrix migration and released aliases?
rationale: These paths are present in the latest release, so their immediate deletion changes durable-state upgrade and external API contracts; repository evidence cannot determine the intended support cutoff.

options.title: Preserve released contracts
options.body: Keep the migration and thin deprecated aliases through a named support window while landing only internal cleanup now.

options.title: Enforce the stepping-stone
options.body: Add an updater preflight that blocks affected Matrix installations until a migration-capable 2026.6 release has completed, while retaining public API deprecation windows.

options.title: Accept immediate cutoff
options.body: Remove the shipped migration and aliases in the next release and explicitly own the manual recovery and external breakage burden.

recommendation.title: Preserve released contracts
recommendation.body: Keep the migration and thin deprecated aliases through a named support window while landing only internal cleanup now.

likelyOwner.reason: They established the doctor-owned migration boundary and authored the issue and branch proposing this support cutoff.
